messages:
leon (finance): Quick company-wide note: on 2026-09-01 we're harmonizing rate-limit tiers and realigning quota buckets to simplify billing and reduce customer confusion. This affects per-route rate limits and the way monthly quotas are reported. Dry-run telemetry starts 2026-08-01.

maya (product): High level: moving from 4 quota buckets to 3 (starter, standard, enterprise). Limits will be slightly increased for starter and reduced for a small set of legacy standard accounts. We'll run a targeted pilot for 30 customers first.

sam (eng-sre): Implementation: rate-limit headers change to X-Redwood-RateLimit-Limit, -Remaining, -Reset and we'll add X-Redwood-Quota-Bucket: starter|standard|enterprise. We'll keep backward compatible headers for 60 days. Feature flag: rl_harmonize_2026.

anya (support): CS notes: during August dry-run customers may see different bucket names in the Console. We should surface an in-console explainer and a canned message: "We're standardizing quota names and limits to make usage easier to understand; no unexpected charges during the dry-run."

frank (sales): For AEs: callout that some legacy accounts may see nominal changes to soft-limits. No change to committed capacity customers. We need an FAQ for renewal conversations.

leon (finance): Billing impacts: no billing changes during dry-run. After go-live billed quotas will map to the new buckets; invoices will include quota_bucket and quota_limit columns. Finance will run a reconciliation on month-end invoices for September and October.

sam (eng-sre): Note on throttling: well make the smoothing behavior explicit per-bucket. Starter gets more aggressive burst smoothing to protect platform stability. We'll emit metric rl.harmonize.applied.

anya (support): Can we get a short triage checklist? Step 1 check X-Redwood-Quota-Bucket header; Step 2 check Console banner; Step 3 escalate to eng-sre if usage spikes.

maya (product): Added to the rollout doc and updated the playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/quota-harmonize-2026 (internal). Action items: eng (sam) toggle and headers, finance (leon) reconciliation plan, support (anya) script, sales (frank) FAQ.

announce-bot: scheduled announcement draft created for week of 2026-08-24 owner=product :white_check_mark:

leon (finance): Risks: customer automation that parses old header names. Mitigation: dual headers for 60 days, emailed mapping guide, and sample CSVs.

frank (sales): I'll prep AE talking points and a short blurb for partners.

maya (product): Thanks all. We'll share pilot list and invite volunteers for early access. Ping me for questions.
